blind.description: A lidless stone coffin or sarcophagus with one square end and one rounded end, featuring gothic arch relief panels carved into its exterior stone rim. Inside lies a mummified body wrapped in beige linen bandages, accented with a reddish-brown cloth draped over its midsection. The geometry is solid and watertight with stylized, hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: An elongated rounded-rectangular stone basin with thick masonry borders containing a wrapped mummy lying flat, with its head nestled into the rounded end and a brown fabric wrap across its torso.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 feet tall (roughly one-fourth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 6.5 to 7 feet long (slightly longer than the figure is tall).
